facts.fact: The Global Fund's Inspector General states that the national health management information system (DHIS2) has been rolled out at all health facilities, and lists the network as referral, provincial and district hospitals, 505 health centres and 1,250 health posts; audit period July 2021 to December 2023.

The Inspector General states that data is reported into DHIS2 at the health facilities, after monthly validation meetings led by the heads of facilities, and that the rollout removed the need for manual reporting; audit period July 2021 to December 2023, 13 facilities visited.

The Inspector General states DHIS2 is rolled out at all health facilities; it gives no numerator, its footnote lists 1,819 facilities of which 1,763 are health centres, medicalized health centres and health posts, and the statement rests on visits to 13 facilities in 10 districts; audit period July 2021 to December 2023.

The Inspector General describes DHIS2 as the national system under a control environment set by the Ministry of Health: ministry standard operating procedures at 100% of the 13 sites visited, ministry and Rwanda Biomedical Centre supervision at all of them, and ministry staff correcting data in DHIS2; audit period July 2021 to December 2023.

systems.tiers: rolled out at all health facilities

systems.system: laboratory specific data systems (HIV viral load)
systems.tiers: centralized laboratory results; not interoperable with DHIS2 or the health registers

note: Global Fund OIG audit GF-OIG-24-20 of 16 December 2024. It also reports verification factors above 95% on five of six sampled indicators, standard national data tools at 85% of sites, dedicated data staff at 92%, and variances of 7 to 15% on HIV viral load indicators, which it puts down to data split across registers, laboratory systems and DHIS2 with no interoperability. It names no plan or budget line for DHIS2 and says no codified monitoring and evaluation plan exists. IFMIS, the public finance system, is not a health information system and is left out.
